body:
Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is the first model released by DiffuSpace, delivering state-of-the-art performance among open-source diffusion language models at release on the benchmarks reported in our launch blog.

## Ficha rápida

- Diffuspace/Clover-35B-A3B-Preview
- 35B parámetros
- 3.0B activos (MoE)
- VRAM mínima estimada 24 GB (GPU 24 GB)
- ~354 tok/s en RTX 4090 (Q4)
- licencia apache-2.0
- 199 likes en Hugging Face

## Descripción original

Clover-35B-A3B-Preview is the first model released by DiffuSpace, delivering state-of-the-art performance among open-source diffusion language models at release on the benchmarks reported in our launch blog. Clover combines a 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts backbone with approximately 3B active parameters per token, block diffusion generation, and a 128K context window.

See the benchmark discussion for evaluation results, settings, and comparisons.

Clover is a text-only model derived from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, retaining its hybrid Gated DeltaNet (GDN) / full-attention MoE backbone with 40 layers, 256 routed experts, top-8 token routing, and one shared expert per layer.

- Bidirectional block attention: additional learned GDN parameters, including right-convolution weights and softmax controls, let tokens attend within a noisy block while preserving a causal prefix. - 128K context: up to 131,072 tokens for the prompt and generated response together. - Block diffusion with LowConfidence decoding: this Hugging Face implementation starts each block with masked tokens and resolves confident positions in parallel. Positions with confidence above the threshold are filled; if none qualify, the most confident position is filled to ensure progress.
